Product Details: The Solar Energy Kit is a comprehensive educational learning kit designed to help students understand the fundamentals of solar power and renewable energy. It demonstrates how sunlight is converted into electrical energy using a photovoltaic solar panel, making science concepts easy to understand through practical experiments. The kit includes essential components such as a solar panel, connecting wires, LED, DC motor, and other accessories that allow students to build and test various solar-powered projects. Ideal for physics laboratories, STEM education, science exhibitions, and classroom demonstrations, this kit promotes hands-on learning, innovation, and environmental awareness.
